title: terrain/cellstate.json
description: Placement and legend of terrain/cellstate.png, the routing-grid cell states (F1: assessed / blocked / unknown) for hatching unknown terrain. PNG encoding as the field PNGs: 8-bit RGBA, counts = R*256 + G (0 assessed, 1 blocked), B = 0, A = 255 known, A = 0 unknown (state 2, incl. non-HiRISE and no data). One PNG pixel per routing cell, rows north to south. Written by make web from WS1's cellstate_3m.tif (tools/make_web.py). Added in v1.1.0.
x-source: SPEC §2.2 F1 (unknown drawn hatched); brief WS1 (cellstate_3m.tif); WS5 STATUS (no cell-state web file)

image.description: PNG path relative to the data root (terrain/cellstate.png)

bounds.description: [w, s, e, n] lon/lat deg of the outer pixel edges

codes.description: state code -> label (0 assessed, 1 blocked, 2 unknown)

pct.description: share of the image's cells in each state, %
